title: All You Need is Love
description: This retro-inspired theme will create a world where all you need is love. After all, love is the foundation of the hope and educational resources that the Parent Child Center helps provide to make families stronger. With a nod to the peace and love era, this colorful concept will be a wonderful experience for our donors to hear stories of hope.

sections.heading: My Role
sections.content: I managed the event from concept to completion in collaboration with my creative director. I developed initial concepts for the client and designed all creative assets, including the save the date, an invitation, stationery system, and large-format event graphics such as a step and repeat, entrance, bar fronts, and a custom Volkswagen bus. cutout.
